definitions: Inflammation of the nasal passages caused by an allergic reaction to airborne substances such as pollen or dust.
A common allergic condition characterized by symptoms like sneezing, runny nose, itchy eyes, and nasal congestion.
examples: Many people suffer from allergic rhinitis during spring.
She was diagnosed with allergic rhinitis after experiencing persistent sneezing.
Over-the-counter medications can help manage symptoms of allergic rhinitis.
